goals: Preserve the dormant historical Ribbits × Matcha integration identity and planning provenance without assigning active implementation, release, deployment, or testing work.
Reactivate only after explicit approval of a feature whose purpose materially depends on both the canonical Ribbits project and Matcha Flavoured.
scope: Preserve the canonical controls, immutable UUID, stable repository project ID/path, display identity, aliases, and historical log for this dormant integration identity.

Record the supersession of the former Matcha-cartographer map concept: the canonical Ribbit Village Explorer Map belongs to the canonical Ribbits project, with Phase C availability through witch-hut content and Phase D sale of the same canonical map by the Wandering Ribbit; neither source materially depends on Matcha.
Keep all implementation, build, artifact, release, deployment, Test Slot, and runtime work inactive unless an explicitly approved reactivation feature materially depends on both Ribbits and Matcha.

exclusions: Implementation source, build files, generated resources, artifacts, Canary versions, or speculative scaffolding while the project remains PARKED.

Ownership or implementation of the canonical Ribbit Village Explorer Map, including Phase C witch-hut availability and Phase D Wandering Ribbit sale, plus all other Ribbits-native features that do not materially depend on Matcha; those remain owned by the canonical Ribbits project.

Unrelated Matcha changes, a general Matcha villager-trade overhaul, blanket replacement of Matcha trade sets, or modification of Matcha progression beyond the explicitly approved Ribbits integration behavior.
Automatic mirroring of every current or future Matcha trade without an explicit mapping contract and compatibility rationale.
Replacing swamp huts with Ribbits villages, suppressing either structure's independent world generation, sharing one structure identity, or repurposing Matcha's existing swamp-hut explorer map.
Copying or redistributing protected Ribbits or private Matcha material beyond what is lawfully available and necessary for local compatibility work.
Deployment, Test Slot occupancy, Minecraft launch, runtime-state mutation, protected gameplay-instance access, or runtime-validation claims while the project is parked.

dependencies.requirement: A runtime-functional canonical Minecraft 26.2 Ribbits release with the exact entities, professions, village structure identity, and integration surfaces required by the implemented workstream.
dependencies.reason: Cross-system behavior must extend the canonical Ribbits implementation without duplicating or taking ownership of its native content.
Exact game target whose villager trades, explorer maps, structure locate behavior, persistence, and server contracts must be respected.
Minecraft 26.2 Fabric loader baseline for the eventual compatibility implementation.
Current Fabric API baseline; supported trade, lifecycle, networking, and other integration hooks should be preferred where applicable.

dependencies.requirement: The exact current Minecraft 26.2 Matcha Flavoured stack and authoritative integration contracts must be audited before each implemented workstream.
dependencies.reason: This project exists specifically to integrate Ribbits with Matcha behavior rather than to reproduce an assumed or stale Matcha contract.

state.milestone: The Ribbits × Matcha Integration project is deliberately PARKED as a dormant historical identity. The canonical Ribbit Village Explorer Map is now owned by the canonical Ribbits project, with Phase C availability through witch-hut content and Phase D sale of the same map by the Wandering Ribbit; neither source materially depends on Matcha, and no other specific Matcha-dependent Ribbits feature is approved. UUID, stable repository project ID/path, display identity, aliases, and history remain preserved. Reactivation requires an explicitly approved feature whose purpose materially depends on both Ribbits and Matcha; no implementation or runtime candidate exists.
